jobs.description: Worldwide Sales & New Business Development Neschen, part of Henkel, develops and manufactures self-adhesive graphic media and coating solutions. Our portfolio includes printable media, protective laminates and mounting films for applications in signage, retail graphics, displays and visual communication. To accelerate our international growth, we are looking for a commercially driven Account Manager with a clear hunter mindset. You enjoy approaching new customers, understanding their applications and turning opportunities into profitable, lasting business. What you will do Win new customers: Identify, approach and win distributors, graphics-material suppliers, print service providers and customers with relevant graphics applications. Engage end customers and specifiers: Build relationships with retailers, brand owners, designers, architects and agencies. Understand their projects, provide advice, samples and application support, and establish Neschen products in material selections and specifications. Turn projects into sales: Work with distributors, print service providers and application partners to convert product selections into orders and repeat business. Develop international markets: Build growth plans for priority markets, recruit suitable distribution partners and expand our portfolio within existing accounts. Lead the sales process: Own every step from prospecting and qualification through trials and commercial proposals to negotiation and closing. Connect customers with our expertise: Work closely with product management, application technology, development and marketing, and bring market feedback back into the company. Deliver profitable growth: Take responsibility for agreed sales, margin and new-business targets, supported by a qualified pipeline and reliable CRM forecasts. What you bring Proven experience in technical B2B sales, with clear examples of winning new customers and developing profitable business A proactive, persistent and results-oriented approach: you start conversations, identify projects and follow through to closing Experience in graphics, visual communication, large-format printing, self-adhesive films, laminates, mounting products or related materials Experience working with distribution partners, end customers and specifiers; an established industry network and experience in securing specifications are an advantage Technical curiosity and an understanding of how material selection affects printing, finishing, installation and application Strong communication, presentation and negotiation skills, and the ability to build trust across countries and cultures A structured, independent and collaborative way of working A degree in business, engineering or a related field, or equivalent practical experience Fluent German and English, as you will work with customers and colleagues worldwide; further languages are an advantage Willingness to travel internationally  What we offer An international role with clear responsibility for winning customers and growing Neschen's Graphics business A broad portfolio of graphic media, supported by experienced product and application specialists The chance to influence product selection from the early stages of customer projects The expertise of Neschen in graphic media and coating technologies, and the strength of Henkel behind it A competitive salary package with a performance-related bonus Technical training, professional development and an international team that values initiative, accountability and cooperation. Flexible working hours Attractive benefits under the chemical industry collective agreement, including an employer-funded company pension and long-term care insurance Ready to turn opportunities into business? We value diversity and welcome applications regardless of gender, age, disability, ethnic origin, religion or belief, sexual orientation or gender identity. Applicants with severe disabilities will be given preference if equally qualified.

jobs.occupation: Assistant Professor of Organic Chemistry (f/m/d) (Professor/in - Hochschulen)
jobs.description: Constructor University (formerly Jacobs University) is a private, state-accredited, English-language university in Bremen. We offer Bachelor, Master, and PhD programs in three schools: School of Science, School of Computer Science and Engineering, and School of Business, Social and Decision Sciences. Our principles are first-class teaching and research, international diversity, and multidisciplinary cooperation. Constructor University consistently achieves top results in national and international university rankings. As an international university, we attract highly talented and open-minded students from all over the world. Currently, over 1.800 students from 110 nations live and study on our residential campus.Constructor University is seeking to fill a tenure-track faculty position in organic chemistry with a focus on synthetic organic chemistry, and we invite applications from interested candidates for the following position, to be filled ideally by January 2027:Assistant Professor of Organic Chemistry (f/m/d)(full-time, tenure-track, initially limited to 3 years)Your Responsibilities:The School of Science is particularly interested in a candidate who combines experimental and computational or theoretical approaches for the development of synthetic methodology and synthesis of bioactive molecules or functional materials. The implementation of AI, machine learning, or data-driven control / optimization is highly welcome, for example, for synthesis planning, activity prediction, sensing, or structural topology. The successful candidate is expected to engage in innovative research in organic chemistry and to maintain a cutting-edge, externally funded research program that energizes the School of Science.The successful candidate will conduct teaching in the field of organic chemistry, including fundamental and advanced lectures and laboratories at the BSc, MSc, and PhD level. The expertise in teaching organic chemistry forms an integral part of the basic education in the BSc programs “Chemistry and Biotechnology” and “Medicinal Chemistry and Chemical Biology”. Moreover, the candidate is expected to take a pivotal role in the MSc programs “Quantitative Life Science” and/or “Advanced Materials” with complementary research experience and via the development and implementation of innovative, pedagogically sound approaches to online, hybrid and in-person teaching and learning. This will also include the advising of students on their studies, and the supervision of Bachelor, Master, and PhD theses as well as research projects.The university is highly supportive of junior faculty, providing both formal and informal mentoring, administrative support, as well as a flexible budget for establishing an internationally visible research group. The University offers in-house adequate shared analytical research facilities, including NMR spectrometers, single crystal diffractometers, and high-resolution mass spectrometers. jobs.occupation: PhD Researcher (m/f/d) AI for Semantic Structures, Reasoning Flows & Personalized Content Generation (Wissenschaftliche/r Mitarbeiter/in)
jobs.description: Become a part of our journey and join the Constructor Community as:PhD Researcher (m/f/d): AI for Semantic Structures, Reasoning Flows & Personalized Content GenerationYou are expected to contribute to the development of internationally visible, foundational research in AI-driven semantic structure extraction, automated reasoning-flow modeling, and adaptive content generation. The research focuses on methods for analyzing and representing deep semantic and pedagogical structures in scientific and educational materials; high-fidelity extraction of conceptual and reasoning blocks; inference-time rationale generation; and adaptive, learner-aware sequencing of content. This includes work on semantic parsing, structured NLP, graph-based neural models, metacognitive prompting, ontology alignment across disciplines, and human-in-the-loop optimization.In this context, interdisciplinary research is strongly encouraged—particularly collaborations spanning computer science, computational linguistics, cognitive science, and the learning sciences. You will contribute to developing datasets, baseline models, personalized learning engines, reasoning-graph representations, cross-domain mapping algorithms, and RLHF-style feedback loops that improve system interpretability and instructional quality. The successful candidate will also contribute to high-quality publications, release research prototypes, and support demonstrator systems that deliver structured semantic extraction, rationale-aware content generation, and cross-domain transfer of reasoning structures.Additionally, the successful candidate is expected to support teaching activities in areas such as Machine Learning, Natural Language Processing, AI in Education, Knowledge Representation, and Python-based analytical seminars at the BSc, MSc, and PhD levels. Responsibilities include assisting in course delivery, advising students, supervising Bachelor/Master theses, and engaging in methodological innovation for online, hybrid, and in-person learning environments. The university provides strong support for early-career researchers, including mentorship, administrative assistance, access to computational resources, conference funding, and opportunities to collaborate with other research groups and industrial partners working at the intersection of AI and digital education.Your Profile- Master’s or PhD degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Computational Linguistics, or a related field.- Strong research interest and practical experience in one or more of the following areas: - semantic parsing and structured representation learning- knowledge graphs or graph-based reasoning- transformer models, sequence modeling, or GNNs- natural language generation and explainability- educational AI, personalization algorithms, or cognitive modeling- Evidence of research potential through publications, a strong thesis, or significant projects.- Experience or interest in innovative teaching and learning approaches.- Ability to translate theoretical insights into engineered prototypes and systems supporting scientific or educational use cases.- Responsible, self-motivated, and capable of working independently as well as collaboratively.- Excellent verbal and written communication skills.- Intercultural competence and experience in international environments.- Fluency with co-pilot tools for coding and writing.- Fluency in English, the language of instruction and communication on campus.Funding & Appointment TermsThe appointment provides full financial coverage through a dedicated fellowship, comprising:- Monthly stipend of €1,650- Monthly research-cost allowance of €100 (Forschungskostenpauschale)- Health-insurance subsidy of €100 per month- Supplementary €550 mini-job allowance to support parallel part-time employment (optional)Application Details- Expected start date: February, 2026Application package must include:- Curriculum Vitae (CV)- Academic transcripts- A detailed letter of motivation outlining research interests and career goals- 2 recommendation lettersApplications to be reviewed on a rolling basis. Shortlisted candidates will be invited to interviews.

ideally financial services.• German language skills.What we offer as an employer• Join an Innovative Leader: Be part of a pioneering SaaS tech company recognised as the global standard in its jobs.description: Work Your Magic with us!Ready to explore, break barriers, and discover more? We know you’ve got big plans – so do we! Our colleagues across the globe love innovating with science and technology to enrich people’s lives with our solutions in Healthcare, Life Science, and Electronics. Together, we dream big and are passionate about caring for our rich mix of people, customers, patients, and planet. That's why we are always looking for curious minds that see themselves imagining the unimaginable with us.Your role:In this pivotal role, you will shape the future of safe and compliant product transport across a broad global life science portfolio, driving regulatory excellence at scale. We believe that this variety drives excellence and innovation, strengthening our ability to lead in science and technology. jobs.occupation: Project Engineer (Projektleiter/in / Projektmanager/in)
jobs.description: VetterTec is an innovative company headquartered in Kassel, Germany, with more than 95 years of experience in the development and manufacturing of machinery and systems for industrial drying and dewatering, particularly for the food processing industry. With a team of more than 160 employees across six locations and an international sales share exceeding 80%, we offer an exciting and dynamic working environment.To support our continued growth, we are looking for a Project Engineer who is passionate about driving technically demanding projects to success.As a Project Engineer, you take ownership of projects from kick-off through final handover, both technically and organizationally. Acting as the customer's main point of contact, you work closely with Technical Engineering, Process Engineering, Procurement, and site teams to ensure successful project execution. This role is ideal for someone who leads through technical expertise and practical experience, with a strong focus on technical project responsibility rather than pure project coordination.Your Responsibilities:- Full project ownership from order handover to technical and commercial handover (TOC) - budget, schedule, risk and scope- Single point of contact for the customer throughout the project- Functional leadership of the core project team - holding the team's capacity together and keeping the project moving as one- Technical judgment: understanding the equipment and the process well enough to challenge assumptions and demand the right decisions at the right time- On-site presence at the milestones that matter — project kick-off, construction start, mechanical and electrical completion, commissioning start, and the final performance run (Leistungsfahrt) through handover- Presence at key suppliers for the acceptance (FAT) of critical components- Running the team's agile rhythm - weekly syncs, a shared task board, rolling short-term planning, and visualizing progress - and adjusting quickly when the project needs it- Integrating the contributions of Technical Engineering, Process Engineering, Procurement, Manufacturing, Installation and Commissioning into one coherent project, without replacing any of themWhat You Bring:- Professional experience in international plant or equipment engineering (Anlagenbau), ideally with process or industrial equipment- A hands-on, practical mindset — someone who has stood on a shop floor or a construction site, not only in front of a screen; we weigh practical experience over theoretical credentials- A mechanical engineering background as a Techniker (completed apprenticeship plus Techniker) or a comparable practical qualification (Bachelor's / FH degree)- Experience in vessel and plant construction (Anlagen- und Behälterbau) - manufacturing methods and welding processes- Project management capability - comfortable owning budget, schedule and risk - with a technical center of gravity- Business-fluent English (must-have); German is a plus, not a requirement- Willingness to travel internationally, including assignments of around two weeks at a time- Comfortable leading a team with lightweight agile practices - task boards, short review cycles, rolling planning - rather than heavyweight process- Professional or Senior level - we are hiring at bothHow We Work:- Projects follow a clear phase structure, but day to day we work in short cycles — weekly team syncs, a shared task board, and rolling four-to-six-week planning alongside the overall schedule- Remote work is possible for this role, with on-site presence expected for supplier acceptances of key components and for construction and site activities- You don't need to be based in Germany- Onboarding starts in the office; afterwards, your working pattern is by arrangement- A relaxed, direct working atmosphere — we'd rather solve a problem in the team meeting than escalate itWhat We Offer:- Real ownership of international projects from kick-off through commissioning and final handover- A technically challenging role with a high level of responsibility and the opportunity to shape Project Engineering at VetterTec- A collaborative, solution-oriented culture with short decision-making processes- 30 days of annual leave, attractive working conditions, and a competitive compensation package- Comprehensive employee benefits, including bike leasing, subsidized public transportation, Corporate Benefits, and additional company benefits- Extensive personal and professional development opportunities in an international environment﻿Please don't spend time writing a cover letter. jobs.occupation: Global Salesforce Business Analyst & Admin (m/f/d) – Customer Service & Platform (Business-Analyst/in)
jobs.description: Introduction/About usAs Global Salesforce Business Analyst & Admin (m/f/d) - Customer Service & Platform, you are responsible for analyzing, shaping, documenting, and supporting the implementation of business requirements for the Customer Service and Platform stream within the global Customer Engagement ecosystem (Salesforce CRM), with a strong focus on Salesforce Service Cloud and Platform capabilities.You act as the key interface between Customer Service stakeholders, Product Owners, technical teams, and regional or local CRM specialists. The role combines strong Business Analysis capabilities with hands-on Salesforce configuration knowledge. You translate business needs into clear, testable user stories and solution concepts and can independently implement approved no-code and low-code changes within the applicable governance framework.Your focus is on scalable, harmonized, and user-centered Customer Service and Platform solutions. You ensure that global processes can be adopted effectively across regions while enabling appropriate localization for market-specific operational and regulatory requirements. You contribute functional and technical expertise across case management, customer interactions, knowledge, entitlements, service channels, automation, data quality, reporting, and related integrations.Your responsibilitiesBusiness Analysis and Requirements Engineering- Plan, facilitate, and document workshops, interviews, process mapping, and refinement sessions with global and local Customer Service stakeholders; analyze processes, pain points, objectives, user needs, dependencies, risks, and business value.- Translate business needs into complete, consistent, testable, and traceable epics, features, user stories, acceptance criteria, process flows, business rules, data, and non-functional requirements aligned with platform strategy and scope.- Challenge demands and identify opportunities to standardize, simplify, reuse, automate, or leverage existing Salesforce capabilities.- Maintain and prioritize the backlog with the Product Owner based on value, urgency, risk, effort, dependencies, and strategic alignment; document requirements and decisions in JIRA and Confluence.Functional Solution Design and Salesforce Configuration:- Design maintainable Service Cloud and Platform solutions with Product Owners, architects, developers, integration specialists, data teams, and other platform streams, assessing standard functionality, configuration, low-code automation, integration, or custom development.- Configure approved no-code and low-code changes within governance and deployment processes, including objects and fields, layouts, Dynamic Forms, record types, Lightning pages, list views, queues, assignment and validation rules, reports, dashboards, Flow automation, and other declarative capabilities.- Create prototypes or proof-of-concept configurations and assess end-to-end impacts on processes, data, integrations, automation, reporting, permissions, mobile use, and dependent platform streams.- Ensure compliance with architecture, security, access-control, data protection, naming, documentation, and release standards; collaborate with developers for Apex, Lightning Web Components, or other coded solutions, as software development is outside the role.Customer Service Process and Platform Ownership Support- Serve as functional expert for Customer Service processes and Service Cloud, including case lifecycle, inquiries, interaction history, routing and queues, service channels, knowledge, entitlements and milestones, templates, automation, and reporting.- Drive consistent end-to-end processes and data flows across Customer Service, Sales, Marketing, Technical Service, and connected systems; evolve reusable global templates while enabling justified, controlled localization.- Identify improvements to agent productivity, first-contact resolution, response quality, process transparency, and customer experience.- Support the responsible evaluation and adoption of AI-enabled and automation capabilities, including Agentforce where applicable.Testing, Release, and Deployment Support- Define test scenarios and expected results; prepare and execute functional testing and support integration, end-to-end, regression, and user acceptance testing.- Triage defects, clarify expected behavior, support root-cause analysis, and coordinate resolution with the appropriate teams.- Support release planning, readiness, deployment preparation, release notes, post-deployment validation, and hypercare; help prioritize incidents, defects, process gaps, and enhancements.Stakeholder Collaboration and Enablement- Build trusted relationships with global and local Customer Service stakeholders; communicate effectively with business and technical audiences and facilitate decisions by clearly presenting options, trade-offs, impacts, recommendations, and open points.- Guide local CRM specialists on market adoption, training, end-user support, and complex or escalated topics.- Create or support process documentation, user guidance, release communications, training materials, and enablement concepts.- Contribute to cross-regional communities of practice and promote consistent Business Analysis and Salesforce configuration standards.Data, Reporting, and Operational Support- Ensure the quality, consistency, integrity, and appropriate use of Customer Service and cross-stream Platform data, including cases, interactions, accounts, contacts, knowledge, entitlements, and service history.- Define reporting requirements and create or support reports and dashboards for operational management, service performance, adoption tracking, and continuous improvement.- Analyze incidents, user feedback, process performance, and platform usage to identify improvements; provide expert functional support for complex or escalated topics and coordinate with technical teams as needed.Your qualifications- Degree in business administration, economics, IT, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience.- At least 5 years in Business Analysis, CRM, Customer Service, commercial operations, or a related field—preferably Pharma/Life Sciences—including 3+ years of hands-on Salesforce Service Cloud experience in a BA, Functional Consultant, Administrator, or similar role.- Expertise in requirements elicitation, process analysis, workshops, user stories, acceptance criteria, backlog refinement, stakeholder alignment, agile delivery, JIRA, and Confluence.- Hands-on Salesforce declarative and low-code configuration, including Flow; able to implement governed code-free changes and assess automation, errors, maintainability, and testing.- Strong Service Cloud knowledge: case management, routing/queues, channels, knowledge, entitlements, automation, security, data models, reporting, and integrations.- Experience in functional testing, UAT, defect triage, releases, and hypercare; knowledge of role-based access, profiles/permission sets, data protection, auditability, and controlled deployments.- Salesforce Business Analyst certification required or obtainable within an agreed period; Administrator and Service Cloud Consultant certifications strongly preferred.- Strong analytical, conceptual, problem-solving, facilitation, documentation, stakeholder-management, and communication skills; able to balance value, user experience, standardization, risk, and maintainability.- Structured, independent, collaborative, results- and detail-oriented; accountable, interculturally competent, fluent in English, additional languages advantageous, and willing to travel internationally at least 30% as required.What we offerJoin #futurefresenius and drive the future of MedTech Quality with us. Make an impact in a strategic role that shapes organizational excellence in medical technology.ContactApply now through our online portal to submit your application and join our team.

"Taste the power of food" - and lead the way in shaping what food looks like tomorrow! Your tasks include: Developing and implementing product and innovation projects from initial idea to successful market launch Identifying and evaluating market, food and consumer trends and deriving new product and concept ideas Further developing and managing a structured innovation process, including evaluation, piloting and implementation Developing economically viable innovation concepts, taking into account customer benefit, operational feasibility and margin targets Coordinating pilot projects and cross-site roll-outs, with continuous optimisation based on data and feedback Working initiatives Fostering a culture of innovation through workshops, idea exchange and cross-functional collaboration What you bring: A degree in Food Technology, Nutrition Science or a comparable qualification At least 7 years of professional experience in project management, product development or innovation management within the food industry Ideally, experience in a B2B environment, e.g. with ingredient, spice or food manufacturers Proven experience in delivering projects from initial idea to market launch Experience in designing and managing innovation and product development processes Excellent project management and stakeholder management skills The ability to translate market and consumer trends into concrete, actionable concepts Commercial understanding of margins, supply chain and operational requirements in the food sector A structured, delivery-focused personality with an entrepreneurial mindset and a passion for food Willingness to travel within the group, including project-based stays of 1-2 weeks at our sites in Austria and the UK Excellent German and English skills What you can expect from us: A secure job within a growing group of companies Career
